skills.name: AI tool fluency
skills.description: Using generative AI assistants effectively for drafting, summarising, searching and ideation, and knowing when not to use them.

skills.name: Verifying AI output
skills.description: Checking AI-generated text, code, figures or images for errors, bias, invented facts and policy or privacy problems before they are used.

skills.name: Responsible and ethical AI use
skills.description: Applying data-protection, fairness, transparency and safety principles when AI tools touch customers, students, patients or clients.

skills.name: Machine learning engineering
skills.description: Building, evaluating, deploying and monitoring machine-learning models and AI-powered features.

skills.name: Technological literacy
skills.description: Confidently using digital systems, learning new software quickly and understanding how the tools you rely on work.

skills.name: Data analysis
skills.description: Cleaning, analysing and interpreting data with spreadsheets, SQL or programming to support decisions.

skills.name: CRM and ticketing systems
skills.description: Working in customer relationship management and case-management systems to log, route and resolve customer requests.

skills.name: Conversation design
skills.description: Designing chatbot and voice-assistant flows, writing knowledge-base content and improving automated conversations.

skills.name: Networks and cybersecurity
skills.description: Protecting systems and data: secure configuration, threat awareness, access control and incident response.

skills.name: Software design and architecture
skills.description: Turning requirements into maintainable system designs, interfaces and data models.

skills.name: Software testing and quality assurance
skills.description: Designing tests, automating test suites and validating that software behaves correctly and safely.

skills.name: Cloud and DevOps
skills.description: Deploying, operating and automating software on cloud infrastructure with CI/CD, monitoring and infrastructure as code.

skills.name: Design and user experience
skills.description: Researching users and designing usable, accessible digital products, from user flows to interactive prototypes.

skills.name: Visual communication design
skills.description: Typography, layout, colour, illustration and brand systems that communicate ideas clearly.

skills.name: Motion and 3D design
skills.description: Creating animation, motion graphics and 3D visuals for screens, video and products.

skills.name: Financial reporting
skills.description: Preparing financial statements and reports that comply with accounting standards and regulation.

skills.name: Tax and regulatory compliance
skills.description: Applying tax law and regulation, preparing returns and representing clients in disputes.

skills.name: Audit and forensic investigation
skills.description: Examining records, controls and transactions to provide assurance or to investigate fraud and insolvency.

skills.name: Financial analysis and planning
skills.description: Budgeting, forecasting and analysing the financial impact of business decisions.

skills.name: Curriculum and lesson design
skills.description: Planning learning objectives, sequences and materials aligned to curriculum guidelines.

skills.name: Assessment and feedback
skills.description: Designing fair assessments, marking consistently and giving feedback that helps learners improve.

skills.name: Clinical nursing care
skills.description: Assessing patients, administering treatments and medications, caring for wounds and monitoring responses to care.

skills.name: Health informatics
skills.description: Using health information systems, electronic records and health data to improve care and services.

skills.name: Empathy and active listening
skills.description: Understanding what someone needs and how they feel, and responding with care, especially when they are upset or vulnerable.

skills.name: Clear communication
skills.description: Explaining information simply and accurately in speech and writing, adapted to the audience.

skills.name: Complex problem solving
skills.description: Untangling unusual or ambiguous problems that do not fit a script and finding workable solutions.

skills.name: Professional judgement and ethics
skills.description: Making accountable decisions under uncertainty, guided by professional standards and ethics.

skills.name: Teaching and mentoring
skills.description: Helping others learn: explaining, coaching, motivating and adapting to different learners.

skills.name: Collaboration and negotiation
skills.description: Working across teams and with clients, managing expectations and reaching agreement.

skills.name: Creative thinking
skills.description: Generating original ideas and framing problems in new ways, beyond remixing existing patterns.

skills.name: Curiosity and lifelong learning
skills.description: Continuously updating skills and seeking out new knowledge as tools and roles change.

skills.name: Multilingual communication
skills.description: Serving people in more than one language, for example English, Kiswahili and other local languages.
